scope: Admin app responsive/dynamic CSS conversion + Sell flow BUILD/PARTS fixes (design tokens, fluid widths, rem type, checkbox, chips)

businessFlow.subject: Admin catalog Sell flow renders correctly across viewports with token-driven styles and fixed BUILD/PARTS controls

notes: Converted globals.css to design tokens (all hex/rgba/white moved into :root and consumed via var()), fluid widths via clamp()/rem, and font sizes to rem. Fixed the BUILD Required checkbox (was a bare 60x13 stretched input, now a 17x17 labeled .check control) and the empty Remove-column header (aria-label). PARTS subcategories now render as .partChip chips. Verified headed at 320/375/768/1024/1280px with scrollWidth === clientWidth at every width.
